title.sl: Modalni glagoli v pretekliku: should have
title.de: Modalverben in der Vergangenheit: should have
title.it: I modali al passato: should have
title.en: Looking back: should have, must have

rule.sl:
**should have** + deležnik: bilo bi prav, a se ni zgodilo: **You should have told me.** ({m:Moral|f:Morala} bi mi povedati.) **shouldn't have**: ni bilo prav, a se je zgodilo: **I shouldn't have said that.** Tudi **ought to have**.

**could have**: bilo je mogoče, a se ni zgodilo: **We could have gone by bus.** (Lahko bi šli z avtobusom.)

**must have**: gotovo se je zgodilo: **It must have been Sam.** (Gotovo je bil Sam.) **can't have**, **couldn't have**: gotovo se ni: **It can't have been Poppy.** Tudi **won't have**. Nekateri rečejo *mustn't have*; v britanski pisni rabi velja **can't have**.

**might have**, **may have**, **could have**: morda: **It might have been the wind.**

**needn't have**: {m:storil|f:storila} si, a ni bilo treba: **I needn't have run.** **didn't need to** pove le, da ni bilo treba: **I didn't need to run, so I walked.**

V govoru **should've**, sliši se kot *shoulda*, zato ljudje pišejo tudi *should of*. Pisno velja **should have**.
rule.de:
**should have** + Partizip: wäre richtig gewesen, geschah aber nicht: **You should have told me.** (Du hättest es mir sagen sollen.) **shouldn't have**: war falsch, geschah aber: **I shouldn't have said that.** Auch **ought to have**.

**could have**: wäre möglich gewesen, geschah aber nicht: **We could have gone by bus.** (Wir hätten mit dem Bus fahren können.)

**must have**: sicher war es so: **It must have been Sam.** (Es muss Sam gewesen sein.) **can't have**, **couldn't have**: sicher nicht: **It can't have been Poppy.** Auch **won't have**. Manche sagen *mustn't have*; britisch geschrieben gilt **can't have**.

**might have**, **may have**, **could have**: vielleicht: **It might have been the wind.**

**needn't have**: Du hast es getan, unnötig: **I needn't have run.** **didn't need to** sagt nur, dass es nicht nötig war: **I didn't need to run, so I walked.**

Gesprochen **should've**, es klingt wie *shoulda*, darum schreibt man auch *should of*. Geschrieben gilt **should have**.
rule.it:
**should have** + participio: sarebbe stato giusto, ma non è successo: **You should have told me.** (Avresti dovuto dirmelo.) **shouldn't have**: era sbagliato, ma è successo: **I shouldn't have said that.** Anche **ought to have**.

**could have**: era possibile, ma non è successo: **We could have gone by bus.** (Avremmo potuto prendere l'autobus.)

**must have**: sicuramente è stato così: **It must have been Sam.** (Dev'essere stato Sam.) **can't have**, **couldn't have**: sicuramente no: **It can't have been Poppy.** Anche **won't have**. Alcuni dicono *mustn't have*; lo scritto britannico vuole **can't have**.

**might have**, **may have**, **could have**: forse: **It might have been the wind.**

**needn't have**: l'hai fatto, ma non serviva: **I needn't have run.** **didn't need to** dice solo che non serviva: **I didn't need to run, so I walked.**

A voce **should've**, suona come *shoulda*, perciò si scrive anche *should of*. Per iscritto vale **should have**.
rule.en:
**should have** + the participle: it was right, and it didn't happen: **You should have told me.** **shouldn't have**: it was wrong, and it happened: **I shouldn't have said that.** Also **ought to have**.

**could have**: it was possible, and it didn't happen: **We could have gone by bus.**

**must have**: I'm sure it did: **It must have been Sam.** **can't have**, **couldn't have**: I'm sure it didn't: **It can't have been Poppy.** Also **won't have**. Some people say *mustn't have*; British writing wants **can't have**.

**might have**, **may have**, **could have**: perhaps: **It might have been the wind.**

**needn't have**: you did it, and it wasn't necessary: **I needn't have run.** **didn't need to** says only that it wasn't necessary: **I didn't need to run, so I walked.**

In talk it's **should've**, it sounds like *shoulda*, so people also write *should of*. Writing wants **should have**.

rule.sl: Modalni + **have** + deležnik gleda nazaj: **You should have told me.** (bilo bi prav) **It must have been Sam.** (gotovo) **It can't have been Poppy.** (gotovo ne) **It might have been the wind.** (morda) **I needn't have run.** (ni bilo treba)
rule.de: Modalverb + **have** + Partizip schaut zurück: **You should have told me.** (wäre richtig gewesen) **It must have been Sam.** (sicher) **It can't have been Poppy.** (sicher nicht) **It might have been the wind.** (vielleicht) **I needn't have run.** (unnötig)
rule.it: Modale + **have** + participio guarda indietro: **You should have told me.** (sarebbe stato giusto) **It must have been Sam.** (sicuro) **It can't have been Poppy.** (sicuramente no) **It might have been the wind.** (forse) **I needn't have run.** (non serviva)
rule.en: A modal + **have** + the participle looks back: **You should have told me.** (it was right) **It must have been Sam.** (I'm sure) **It can't have been Poppy.** (I'm sure not) **It might have been the wind.** (perhaps) **I needn't have run.** (no need)

tip.sl: 💡 *{m:Moral|f:Morala} bi povedati* je **should have told**: za should vedno **have** + deležnik.
tip.de: 💡 *Du hättest sagen sollen* ist **You should have told**: das Partizip, nie *should told*.
tip.it: 💡 *Avresti dovuto dire* è **You should have told**: sempre **have** + participio.
tip.en: 💡 Always **have** + the participle: **should have told**, **must have been**.
